Zara: RCA posted for the eviction oscillation incident: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2361234567-eviction-oscillation
Zara: TL;DR: a recently deployed reactive-eviction heuristic plus a new batch scheduler alignment caused cyclical cache thrash under bursty small requests. Impact window ~19m, increased retries and tail latency.
Zara: Doc includes timeline, config diffs, small repro harness, and anonymized request samples. Read before the checkpoint.
Zara: Action items (owners + targets):
- Ethan 	: add a deterministic unit for the eviction timing + pin default heuristic to safe mode 	 target 2026-04-04
- Maya 	: CI integration test for staggered batch alignment and a canary gate 	 target 2026-04-02
- Ethan 	: dashboard + early-warning alert for rising eviction churn (prefetch_hit_ratio < 0.65) 	 target 2026-03-31
Ethan: I'll take the heuristic pin and telemetry. Will open PR and include synthetic load curves.
Maya: I'll draft the CI test. Suggest a 3-step canary (1% -> 10% -> 50%) with health checks between steps.
Zara: Added a short rollback playbook and an ops-runbook note in the doc. Please comment on ownership if different.
Ethan: PR #1422 incoming, adding unit test for eviction debounce and a safe default flag.
OpsBot: Incident record INC-11022 created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-11022
Maya: Scheduling a 20-min checkpoint Friday 09:00 PT to review PR + canary params: https://calendar.internal/meet/eviction-checkpoint
Ethan: +1, will present PR and dashboard mock.
Zara: Thanks all. If you can't make the meeting, leave a short note in the doc. :thumbsup:
